summary: Backend + Frontend testing for Clienti/Strutture overhaul (KLV codes, new fields, media CRUD, client-role security, /api/files with ?auth, units regression, list/detail UI). 11/11 backend tests passed, all core frontend flows verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>6000 lines). Consider splitting endpoints (structures, media, units, clients, logistics) into separate routers for maintainability.

StructureUpdate ignores None values with 'if value is not None' inside update_structure. This works for the current model but blocks intentional null-out of optional fields (e.g. clearing access_details). Currently exclude_unset=True already filters unset — the extra 'is not None' check makes null clears impossible. Consider dropping the redundant check.
structure_media list endpoint returns raw docs — consider using a Pydantic response model to guarantee schema stability.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ prefixed structures/clients/units/media and delete them at teardown. Also cleaned up leftover TEST_* structures and a note on KLV-0002 after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_structures_overhaul.py (pytest, 11 cases). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (falls back to reading /app/frontend/.env). Client-role tests create a fresh client + portal account via POST /api/clients + POST /api/clients/{id}/create-account (email domain must be a real TLD, e.g. @example.com — @kilolava.test is rejected by pydantic EmailStr). Structure PUT drops None values (StructureUpdate) but False/0 do persist as verified for has_units. KLV counter continues across all tests — asserting exact next code is flaky under parallel workers, so we only assert 'new_seq > max_before'.
